title: Sharp tangent inequalities in noncommutative $L_p$-spaces
summary: Let $\mathcal{M}$ be a von Neumann algebra equipped with a faithful normal semifinite weight, and let $L_p(\mathcal{M})$ denote the associated Haagerup noncommutative $L_p$-space. For $1<p<\infty$, let $q=p/(p-1)$. For $z\in L_q(\mathcal{M})$ and $y\in L_p(\mathcal{M})$, denote by $\langle z,y\rangle=\operatorname{Re}\operatorname{Tr}(z^*y)$ the canonical real duality pairing between $L_q(\mathcal{M})$ and $L_p(\mathcal{M})$. Define the normalized duality map by $J_p(x)=\|x\|_p^{\,2-p}u|x|^{p-1}$ for $x=u|x|\neq0$, and set $J_p(0)=0$. We establish the sharp tangent inequality…
